findings.evidence: Lines 101–105 conclude squarefreeness, root equations, and equality of adjoins only; they do not provide the independence, unramifiedness, or presentation-specific assumptions used by degree and splitting theorems.
findings.fix: Restrict the consequence to field-invariant results that can be transported across the displayed equality, and explicitly note that each theorem’s remaining hypotheses must still be established.
findings.issue: The docstring claims that “every statement” about squarefree-radicand fields, including splitting laws, applies verbatim; the theorem proves only equality of the generated intermediate fields, and presentation-dependent results may require additional hypotheses and transport.

summary: All added declarations are documented, but one theorem docstring materially overstates what its conclusion establishes.
